name: Draconia Malfoid (Yule Ball gown)
description: An unofficial, non-commercial fan character, Draconia Malfoid, loosely inspired by Draco Malfoy: a 21-year-old adult woman in an emerald-green off-the-shoulder Yule Ball gown with silver embroidery and a silver necklace. Not affiliated with Warner Bros. or Wizarding World. A proud, sharp-tongued tsundere, secretly caring. The pictures were made with AI.
credit: Draconia Malfoid (Yule Ball gown): an unofficial, non-commercial fan character, pictures made with AI (Grok Imagine).
